name: adapt_feature_flag_javascript_dynamic
description: Dynamic eval, REACTIVE trigger: the disruption fires the first time banner.js's own text contains 'Welcome' (i.e. once the agent has produced a first attempt), then flags.NEW_UI_ENABLED flips under it
prompts: flags.js exports a bool NEW_UI_ENABLED via module.exports. Create banner.js with a function bannerText() that returns "Welcome to the NEW UI!" if NEW_UI_ENABLED else "Welcome!", requiring the flag live from './flags'. Export as module.exports = { bannerText }.
NEW_UI_ENABLED in flags.js may have changed. Make sure bannerText() reflects its CURRENT value, not a stale one.

disruptions.description: flags.NEW_UI_ENABLED flipped false -> true, triggered reactively once banner.js's first draft appeared
